name: ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}
initializeCommand:
alias.devcontainer-env=!f() { set -eu; repo_dir=$(basename "$PWD")
prefix=$(printf '%s\n' "$repo_dir" | LC_ALL=C tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' | LC_ALL=C tr -c 'A-Z0-9_\n' '_')
umask 077
credentials_file=$(mktemp .devcontainer/.env.workspace.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$credentials_file"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

write_env() {
    value=$(printenv "${prefix}_$2" || true)
    if [ "$value" != "$(printf '%s' "$value" | tr -d '\r\n')" ]; then
        printf 'Environment variable %s_%s must be a single line.\n' "$prefix" "$2" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    printf '%s=%s\n' "$1" "$value" >> "$credentials_file"
}

write_env GIT_AUTHOR_NAME DEV_GIT_NAME
write_env GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL DEV_GIT_EMAIL
write_env GIT_COMMITTER_NAME DEV_GIT_NAME
write_env GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL DEV_GIT_EMAIL
write_env GH_TOKEN GH_TOKEN
mv -f "$credentials_file" .devcontainer/.env.workspace; }; f
postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /home/vscode/.codex /home/vscode/.agents /home/vscode/.treehouse && git config --global --add safe.directory "${containerWorkspaceFolder}" && DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 npx --yes skills@1.7.2 add https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/tree/49dd158d1076134a641b33efb035946536778336 --global --agent codex --yes && npm --prefix website ci
